verdict.rationale: Viam's CLI and fleet APIs support bulk-style operations: querying/exporting data and adding/removing tags 'from all data that matches a given filter' (viam-docs-23/33), managing organizations/locations/multiple machines and fragments in bulk (viam-docs-20/34), and SQL/MQL querying across datasets (viam-docs-11). This supports fleet-wide and dataset-wide bulk actions but there's no explicit evidence of bulk actuation commands across many machines/components simultaneously (e.g., batch motor moves) or bulk config updates via CLI beyond fragments. missing for 10: documented bulk command execution across many machines at once, batch config/OTA rollout evidence beyond generic fleet mgmt mention, independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk data operations at scale.
